text:
maria_sales: Client 'Orchid Capital' returned the enterprise auth checklist. main asks: strict one-tenant-per-idp mapping, domain verification tied to auto-claim, SCIM delta only for POC, custom RBAC mapping + nested groups, and for audit they want SAML assertion id in logs.
presales_lee: quick summary: they require domain ownership verification that automatically assigns users on first login to the correct tenant if domain verified. they also want the ability to deny signups from partner domains that share same base domain.
se_rahul: we can do DNS TXT validation for domain ownership and then set a domain->tenant binding. for partner domains (e.g., subcontractor.orchid.co) we can support an explicit deny list or verify subdomain ownership.
infra_eng: SCIM notes: delta-sync available for Okta/AD in GA. for POC we can enable delta as beta (no extra charge) but if IdP lacks change tokens we'll fall back to paged listing every X hours (configurable). we'll surface the sync mode in onboarding UI.
security_bot: audit note: all provisioning events include assertion_id, issuer, and the provisioning mapping id. default audit retention 90d; extended retention available as add-on.
se_rahul: RBAC mapping: we support group->role mapping and custom role names. nested groups depend on IdP features; for Okta we can expand groups and preserve attributes like employeeID or jobTitle. we log the mapping rule id with each provision event.
maria_sales: pricing ask: is domain verification + delta-sync included in trial POC?
presales_lee: POC (3 weeks, up to 1k MAUs) 90-day trial: domain verification included, delta-sync available as beta. extended audit retention is an add-on ($1500/mo for 1 year retention limit for POC). I'll draft exact quote.
infra_eng: implementation tip: we add X-Prov-Context header to SCIM requests with mapping_id and idp_group. this header is recorded in audit logs and included in exports.
legal_ops: I'll review the questionnaire responses and add language about audit log location for Private deployments.
maria_sales: action items: @se_rahul sample SAML metadata + group mapping example, @presales_lee pricing sheet for POC vs annual, @infra_eng confirm fallback poll interval and audit export formats.
se_rahul: sample mapping (paste to them):```json
{"mappings":[{"idp_group":"Okta:Orchid_Admins","tenant":"orchid-core","role":"admin","preserve":["employeeID"]},{"idp_group":"Okta:Orchid_Eng","tenant":"orchid-eng","role":"editor"}]}
```

presales_lee: I'll send the pricing today and schedule kickoff for next Thursday.
security_bot: ticket created INF-4310 for audit retention discussion.
maria_sales: thanks all. I'll compile answers and send back the completed checklist by EOD.
